title: Cressbrook Homestead
axis: +X west across the estimated main dwelling assembly; +Z north outward through House front; +Y up from fixed north House approach.
source: Two named main Cressbrook homestead dwellings only, retained as distinct photo-guided House and Cottage with attached domestic wings/verandas. Official QHR600503heritage parcel centroid[152.40455145, -27.05836679]anchors the assembly; it is NOT a surveyed house centre or building corner. Qualla/Wikidata point is coarse (~0.01degree precision). Saved OSMquery contains no original building plans; unrelated Nominatim Brisbane street results rejected. All component outlines, metric dimensions, courtyard size and separation are explicit photographic reconstructions, not native mapped footprints. Primary heritage text places the homes toward the north of the site and House front northward with a rear southern domestic courtyard. Visualization +Z north (heading pi), +X west. House centre[-30,42]and Cottage[30,42]metres relative to parcel centroid, their60m separation, relative east/west order and offsets are approximate with at least60m registration uncertainty. A separate chapel/whole property is not substituted. Fixed north House approach[-30,55]chosen before terrain/geometry; floor/stumps/steps and exact current host contact unverified.
